title: Full Stack Engineer - Laravel & React/Next.js
description: About the role Small technology team building and operating several B2B software products used in day-to-day business operations. We are looking for a practical and reliable Full Stack Engineer who is comfortable working across both existing applications and newer products. The role includes maintaining Laravel-based systems, developing new features, improving internal tools, and contributing to React and Next.js applications. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys completing real product work, solving operational problems, and taking responsibility for features from development to release. Responsibilities Develop and maintain applications built with PHP and Laravel Build user-facing features using React, Next.js and TypeScript Work with both modern interfaces and existing Blade-based applications Design and integrate REST APIs Investigate bugs and improve existing workflows Write clear, maintainable and testable code Work with relational databases and SQL Review requirements and turn them into practical implementations Support releases and follow production issues when necessary Requirements At least 3 years of professional software development experience Hands-on experience with PHP and Laravel Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript Working knowledge of React and preferably Next.js Experience with REST APIs and relational databases Comfortable using Git in a team environment Ability to understand and improve an existing codebase Strong problem-solving and communication skills Able to work independently and deliver tasks consistently Nice to have Experience with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui or Radix UI Experience with Blade, Bootstrap or jQuery-based applications Familiarity with React Native or Expo Experience with PHPUnit, Vitest or Playwright Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployments Experience with queues, background jobs or Redis Working proficiency in English Application Please include: A short introduction Your current location Links to your GitHub, portfolio or previous work, if available Your experience with Laravel and React/Next.js Your salary expectation Your earliest possible start date

title: Full Stack Developer
description: General Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or a related engineering field, Strong proficiency in PHP and Laravel; solid command of OOP, MVC, and SOLID principles, Proven experience developing projects with React.js and Three.js, Hands-on experience building modern user interfaces with Tailwind CSS, Active use of version control systems (Git, etc.), A habit of writing clean, readable, and reusable code, Strong design sensibility and visual analysis skills, Minimum 5 years of experience with a portfolio to present, Advanced level of English, Solution-oriented, inquisitive, detail-focused, and disciplined, High sense of responsibility and motivation, with strong teamwork skills Job Description Take an active role in developing our PHP and Laravel–based web software projects and updating our existing systems, Deliver end-to-end solutions through both front-end and back-end development, Build interactive and visually rich user interfaces using React.js and Three.js, Ensure software quality and maintainability by writing clean, readable, and reusable code, Manage code changes and contribute to continuous integration through Git and DevOps processes, Participate in the analysis, design, development, and testing of new features, Optimize applications for performance, security, and scalability, Follow current technologies and industry trends and integrate them into projects, Communicate effectively with developers, designers, and business analysts to strengthen team collaboration.

title: React Native Developer (Remote)

The role involves building and maintaining cross-platform mobile applications using React Native technology. Key Responsibilities: • Develop and optimize mobile applications using React Native framework for iOS and Android platforms • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features • Debug and resolve issues across multiple mobile platforms efficiently • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following best practices • Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions Required Skills & Qualifications: • Proficiency in React Native development with at least 2 years of hands-on experience • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend development practices • Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or Context API • Knowledge of mobile app performance optimization techniques • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services • Experience with version control systems like Git • Understanding of mobile app security best practices • Ability to work independently in a remote environment More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development industry, contributing to the delivery of high-quality mobile applications for a diverse user base. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!

title: Senior Backend Developer - Next
description: About the job At HubX we build mobile apps, used and loved by millions all around the world. We have a track record of building and growing mobile apps on various verticals that have reached over 400 million users across 6 continents and 190+ countries. We are looking for a talented "Senior Backend Developer” for the "Next” to join our team. As a talented "Senior Backend Developer” you have plenty of opportunities at your fingertips. So, why should HubX be your next move? We offer you an opportunity to make a huge impact in the lives of millions of users through our products, and even the mobile app industry at large in the next years to come. Ownership is at the core of how we work. From day one, you’re trusted with real responsibility. Together with your team, you’re free to choose a direction, experiment boldly, fail fast, learn, and turn the next idea into something even better. We operate through 7 independent studios, each focused on building and scaling its own products with full end-to-end ownership. This studio model empowers small, cross-functional teams to move fast, make decisions autonomously, and turn ideas into global products. Next Next reimagines how ideas take shape. Through apps like Davinci, Tattoo AI, Wiser and Betterspeak, we build thoughtful, elegant tools and experiences that turn creativity into reality; whether as a visual or a new way of thinking. Every detail is designed to feel seamless yet empowering, helping you create with clarity, joy and control. X Culture: Do What You Love At HubX, we pride ourselves on fostering an environment of collaboration, creativity, and innovation. Our #XCulture is more than just a workplace ethos; it's a lifestyle. We believe passion drives success. Do What You Love isn’t just a motto; it's the foundation of our work. Some of your responsibilities Develop Backend Applications: Work on creating backend applications and enhance the quality of our system architecture. Refine Integrations Between Applications: Improve and fine-tune the integrations to ensure seamless interaction between different applications. Analyze and Resolve Technical Issues: Identify, analyze, and fix technical and application-related problems. Deploy New Releases: Manage the deployment of new software releases to ensure smooth updates. Act as a key technical reference within the backend team in our Istanbul office, providing technical expertise, supporting team coordination, and ensuring alignment with best practices. What we look for Educational Background: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field. Experience: Minimum of 5 year of experience delivering production-ready backend code in an Agile team environment. Technical Knowledge: Solid experience with RESTful APIs, event-driven microservices, and message queues (e.g. Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ), ideally on a cloud-native/serverless stack. Proficiency: Proficient in Node.js (TypeScript) or .NET (C#, .NET Core). Database Knowledge: Knowledge of databases like MongoDB and PostgreSQL. Caching Strategies: Experience with Redis and effective caching strategies. Version Control: Proficient in Git version control, including branching and merging strategies. Nice to have Experience with microservice architectures and event-driven systems Hands-on project experience with GCP, AWS, or other cloud platforms Familiarity with whitelabel system structures and chatbot technologies Experience working with .NET / C# The perks and benefits of working with us We would like you to focus on what you do best, we take care of the rest. Daily essentials: We provide commuting and meal support to make your workday easier. A brand new MacBook and a designed welcome kit. Wellbeing: We support your overall wellbeing with private medical insurance (TSS), HPV vaccination, Heltia membership, and for our women teammates critical women’s health coverage, and annual Beije membership. Gym Reimbursement: We support annual gym membership because we want you to be in tip-top shape psychically and mentally. A unique and top-notch office: Whether you're based in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Maslak district or enjoying panoramic sunset views from the tallest building in Izmir, you'll work in thoughtfully designed spaces built for creativity and collaboration. Our office is also pet-friendly, because we believe great workdays include our furry friends too. Office fuel: Unlimited coffee from XPresso, a fully stocked kitchen with breakfast and snacks throughout the day, and our HubX Breakfast Club, where we come together regularly to start the day with good food and even better conversations. Learning & development: We support your continuous learning with an education budget and weekly Cambly speaking sessions. Team events that create lasting memories, including our traditional All Hands gatherings where the whole company comes together, as well as more humble celebrations and happy hours. Curious about our vibe? Take a look at our Instagram! Strong company culture: Our approach is built on open communication and teamwork, strengthened by our #XCulture and community-driven X clubs that bring people together around shared interests. X Community discounts: Being part of HubX comes with perks, enjoy exclusive discounts and more as a valued member of our community. HubX app memberships: As a HubX teammate, you enjoy complimentary premium access to HubX apps , so you can experience and benefit from the products we build every day. Birthday perks: to celebrate you, we offer a dedicated birthday leave along with a birthday gift voucher , so you can enjoy your special day your way. The Recruiting Process At HubX , we value transparency and efficiency. Here’s a glimpse into our streamlined recruitment process: Application Submission: Apply by submitting your CV, LinkedIn profile, or a brief introduction about yourself. People & Culture Interview: Engage in a conversation with our People & Culture team to discuss your background, aspirations, and how we align with each other’s goals. Case Study Assignment: Showcase your skills through a practical task related to the role. Technical Interview: Meet with your potential team lead for an in-depth review of your case study and technical expertise. Welcome Aboard!: If all goes well, we’re excited to extend an offer and welcome you to the team. Your personal data collected through your job applications will be processed by HubX in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") for the recruitment and evaluation. title: React Native Developer
description: Ekibimizi büyütüyor; bizimle birlikte üretecek, yeni şeyler denemekten keyif alan bir React Native Mobil Geliştirici (0-3 yıl deneyimli) arıyoruz. İster sektöre yeni adım atıyor ol, ister birkaç yıllık tecrüben olsun; bizim için asıl önemli olan işine duyduğun heves ve ekiple yakalayacağımız uyum. Neler Bekliyoruz? 0-3 yıl arası React Native ekosisteminde (JavaScript/TypeScript) pratik tecrübe veya güçlü bir teorik altyapı, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak, Mobil uygulama geliştirme yaşam döngüsüne (iOS ve Android) hakimiyet, State management (Redux, Zustand, Context API vb.) konularında bilgi sahibi olmak, RESTful API'ler ile haberleşme ve veri entegrasyonu konusunda tecrübe (veya öğrenmeye açık olmak), Soru sormaktan çekinmeyen, araştırmacı bir ruh, "Bu bileşeni (component) daha temiz ve yeniden kullanılabilir (reusable) nasıl yazarım?" düşüncesini benimsemek. Şunlar da Varsa Harika Olur (Artı Puanlar) TDD (Test-Driven Development): Test güdümlü geliştirme (Jest, React Native Testing Library vb.) süreçleri hakkında teorik bilgiye veya pratik tecrübeye sahip olmak, Native Dünyaya Aşinalık: İhtiyaç halinde dokunabilecek veya ne olup bittiğini anlayabilecek kadar iOS (Swift/Objective-C) veya Android (Kotlin/Java) native dillerine ilgi duymak, Market Süreçleri ve Otomasyon: App Store / Google Play Store'a uygulama gönderme tecrübesi ve CI/CD (Fastlane vb.) süreçlerine aşinalık, Çevrimdışı (Offline) Mimariler: İnternet bağlantısı koptuğunda bile sorunsuz çalışan uygulamalar tasarlama konusunda teorik veya pratik bilgi. Neler Yapacaksın? Mevcut ve yeni mobil projelerimizin kullanıcı arayüzlerini (UI/UX tasarımlarına uygun olarak) geliştirmek, Backend ekibiyle uyum içinde çalışarak servis entegrasyonlarını kurgulamak, Kod incelemelerine (code review) katılıp ekiple fikir alışverişinde bulunmak, Ürün süreçlerine sadece kod yazarak değil, mobil platformun doğasına uygun yeni fikirler üreterek katkı sağlamak. Neler Sunuyoruz? Hata yapmanın öğrenme sürecinin doğal bir parçası olarak görüldüğü, destekleyici bir çalışma ortamı, Modern teknolojileri pratikte deneyimleyebileceğin projeler,

title: React Native Developer
